columns.title: Exploring
columns.hint: Ideas people ask for in other editors. Not committed.

columns.title: Planned
columns.hint: Known gaps we intend to close.

items.title: Review pull requests in the editor
items.text: Browse and comment on a GitHub pull request next to its diff.

items.title: Jujutsu (jj) support
items.text: A native view of jj changes next to git.

items.title: Multi-repo workspaces
items.text: Several repositories in one window, with their diffs and worktrees side by side.

items.title: Remote development
items.text: Edit over SSH and in dev containers with the same lean editor.

items.title: Settings sync
items.text: Keep settings, keybindings and themes in step across machines.

items.title: Accessibility
items.text: Screen reader support for the editor and the panels.

items.title: Interface translations
items.text: A string layer so the interface can be translated; today it is English only.

items.title: Open folder from inside the app
items.text: Pick a project folder without the command line.

items.title: Desktop notifications on Windows
items.text: Agent sessions already notify on Linux and macOS.

items.title: Reopen terminals with the session
items.text: Remember which terminals were open and their folders across restarts.

items.title: Coverage for more test runners
items.text: pytest, go test and others besides Vitest, Jest and cargo llvm-cov.

items.title: BMP and ICO images
items.text: Open them as pictures like PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and SVG.

items.title: Remember the chosen encoding
items.text: A file reopened with another encoding keeps it after a restart instead of being detected again.

items.title: Stream UTF-16 files
items.text: UTF-16 files are decoded whole into memory; stream them like UTF-8 ones.

items.title: More settings in the settings window
items.text: local_history, watcher_poll_ms, git_worktree_dir and a few more are config-file only today.

items.title: Hook-based status for Gemini CLI and Codex CLI
items.text: Only Claude Code sessions report status through hooks; the others use an output heuristic.

items.title: Kitty keyboard key-release events
items.text: Flag 2 of the protocol is not supported yet.

items.title: Right-to-left polish
items.text: Right-align RTL lines, show inlay hints on them and select across direction runs as one piece.

items.title: Revert merge commits
items.text: The commit menu cannot revert a merge commit yet.

items.title: formatter and code_actions_on_save per language
items.text: Plug them into the per-language overrides of the project settings.

items.title: Pin the Python interpreter in the project file
items.text: It is stored in the state folder today, not in .lumen/config.json.

items.title: Zen mode with split panes
items.text: The text is not centered when a split editor is open.

items.title: TextMate injections
items.text: Code embedded in Markdown or HTML gets only the outer grammar today.

items.title: AI session tabs that do not fit are not drawn
items.text: They stay reachable with Next session waiting for you and the badge; add an overflow menu.

items.title: Restart to update restarts one window
items.text: With several windows open only the window that ran it restarts.

items.title: Raising a window on Wayland
items.text: focus_window may not raise the window; positions cannot be restored by the protocol.

items.title: Uncolored stretch after jumping to the end of a huge file
items.text: The far end of a very large file is uncolored for a few seconds.

items.title: Hands-on pass over every 2026.11.12.1 feature
items.text: The new features were verified by tests and headless renders; we are going through each one by eye, on real machines.

items.title: Windows and macOS checks
items.text: Notifications, save as administrator, multiple windows and the kitty protocol need real-machine testing on both.

items.title: Flaky timing tests
items.text: Two timing tests (watcher poller, local history budget) fail now and then on shared CI runners; make them deterministic.

items.title: Local history
items.text: Snapshots on save and before external rewrites, with diff and restore.

items.title: Hot exit and crash recovery
items.text: Unsaved tabs survive quitting, crashes and kills.

items.title: Persistent undo
items.text: The undo tree comes back when you reopen a file.

items.title: File encodings
items.text: UTF-16, Windows-1252 and many more, detected and saved back.

items.title: Save as administrator
items.text: Write files you lack permission for, through pkexec or the macOS prompt.

items.title: Reopen closed tab
items.text: The last 20 closed tabs, back in their split pane.

items.title: Several AI agent sessions
items.text: One tab per session, a badge, notifications and Next waiting session.

items.title: Git worktrees
items.text: List, create, open, remove and prune; start an agent in one.

items.title: Several terminals and the kitty keyboard protocol
items.text: Terminal tabs and split; modern TUIs get unambiguous keys.

items.title: Replace in project and macros
items.text: Regex captures with a preview; record and replay keys.

items.title: Column selection and jump to character
items.text: Box cursors and flash-style navigation.

items.title: EditorConfig, whitespace, rulers and inline diagnostics
items.text: Per-file indent and charset, visible whitespace, column rulers, Error Lens messages.

items.title: Highlights and linked editing
items.text: Occurrences of the symbol under the caret; paired tag renaming.

items.title: Stashes and the commit graph
items.text: Stash files, apply, pop, drop; coloured lanes over 100k commits.

items.title: Compare refs, line staging, ignore whitespace
items.text: Diff against any ref and stage single lines.

items.title: 3-way merge editor
items.text: Resolve merge, rebase and cherry-pick conflicts conflict by conflict.

items.title: Per-project settings and Python virtualenvs
items.text: .lumen/config.json with trust, per-language overrides, venv detection.

items.title: Mouse bindings, zen mode, explorer sorting, font features
items.text: Bind side buttons, hide every bar, sort the tree, OpenType features.

items.title: Image viewer and spell checking
items.text: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and SVG tabs; harper-ls and typos-lsp.

items.title: Whole-project problems, formatter choice, code actions on save
items.text: Every server-known problem, chosen formatters, organize imports before saving.

items.title: Inline completions
items.text: Ghost text from servers such as GitHub Copilot, with your own login.

items.title: Test coverage in the gutter
items.text: Covered, partial and uncovered bars from lcov or Cobertura.

items.title: Right-to-left text
items.text: Arabic, Hebrew and Persian in visual order with joined shaping.

items.title: Multiple windows
items.text: New window, open a folder in one, drag a tab out.

items.title: Always up to date file watching
items.text: Git events from a terminal refresh the UI; polling on NFS, SMB and FUSE.

items.title: Faster CI and releases
items.text: Pull requests verify in about 3.5 minutes; a release publishes in about 6.6.

items.title: Cut with several cursors
items.text: Ctrl+X no longer deletes the character before a cursor at the end of a short line.

items.title: Lost git refresh after a checkout
items.text: Events within 400 ms of a tree refresh are deferred instead of dropped.

items.title: Stale watch on a recreated folder
items.text: A deleted and recreated folder is watched again.

items.title: Markdown preview extras
items.text: GitHub extras, Mermaid, remote images, selection and TeX math.

items.title: Language server registry
items.text: A built-in table of servers, each started only when installed.

items.title: Signed auto-updates
items.text: Verified downloads, installed where it is safe.

items.title: Test runner and debugger
items.text: Vitest, Jest, cargo; js-debug and gdb DAP.
